what: Seeded sample of routes the milestone-1 map records with an empty guard chain, read by hand and classified. Development set only. Identifiers and categories only; no route string, path or code from a reviewed repository.
seed: the 2 routes per tree with the lowest sha256('guard-sample-2026-10-05|' + case + '|' + methods + '|' + path + '|' + declarationFile + '|' + declarationLine), over every route with zero guard nodes, in each of the 21 trees with routes

categories.not-a-route/http-client: an outbound HTTP client call (fetch wrapper, axios, Angular HttpClient, a test request context)
categories.not-a-route/accessor: a get/put/delete/all call on a store, cache, Map, collection, model or SQL handle
categories.not-a-route/test: a test mock or harness outside the R6 test filter
categories.not-a-route/foreign-spec: an endpoint declaration in a non-Express API-spec library, parsed with the wrong argument as the path
categories.route/missed-guard: a real route that IS behind an authentication or authorization check the map did not record
categories.route/public: a real route that is unauthenticated by design (health, status, docs, a token-in-path push endpoint, a cache-clearing endpoint)
categories.route/undetermined: a real route or registration primitive whose intended exposure could not be settled from the code read

missedGuardMechanisms.armA-02: middleware attached to an endpoint-group object that the routes are declared on, not through use()
missedGuardMechanisms.armA-09: a global use() on the application in another file, and an admin check registered through a security-strategy method call rather than use()
missedGuardMechanisms.heldout-09: a global JWT middleware on the application before the API router is mounted; the routes are declared on a router passed in as a function parameter, so the map loses the link to the application
